name: meribaari
description: MeriBaari: virtual queue tokens for clinics and government offices

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,yellow "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: npm --prefix client run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm --prefix server start
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client run lint && npx --prefix client oxlint server/src server/scripts server/tests
